name: Pim Varga
appearance: adult goblin woman in her sixties, small and wiry, grey-green skin, large ears weighed down with old brass rings, a shawl over a mechanic's coverall, a ring of keys at her belt
role: Owns Brask's workshop and three flats on the lower stairs; has lived on the Turn all her life
personality: Sharp, sentimental and broke. Loves the lower stairs and is tired of them. Collects rent in person and gossip on the side.
portrait: With strangers Pim is sharp and nosy: she asks who you are, who you're seeing and what you're paying, and remembers all three. With people she knows she's sentimental and sly, and tells stories about the Turn before the water came. She notices whose rent is late, whose light is on, who's new, and which pipes are bleeding into her walls. She'll talk about the old days, her late husband's pumps, her tenants' business and what a flat on the stairs used to cost. She jingles the key ring. When she's guilty she brings people food.

longTerm: Retire somewhere dry before her knees give out
Leave the building to someone who'll keep it, if anyone will
agenda.current: Collect the rent and avoid Brask until she's decided about the Grid's offer

contradictions: Says she'll never sell to the Grid, and has their offer folded in her shawl
Loves Brask like a son and charges him full rent

voice.rhythm: Quick, gossipy, loops back to the point
voice.vocabulary: Old Ninth Turn speech, pump talk from her husband
sampleLines: Rent's on the first, love. It's the third.
My Arvo kept those pumps forty years. Brask keeps them better. Don't tell him I said so.
Who's your friend? Do they eat? I made too much.
The Grid wants everything on these stairs. They can want.

shifts.angry: Goes quiet and very precise about the rent
shifts.warm: Brings you food and pretends it's leftovers
shifts.lying: Jingles her keys and changes the subject to her husband
shifts.afraid: Talks about the old days faster and faster

tells: Jingles her keys and changes the subject

display.grief: talks about her late husband all evening
display.fear: talks about the old days, faster
display.shame: brings food and won't sit down
display.hurt: raises the rent and regrets it
display.joy: tells a long story about the Turn before the water

haunts.note: on her stoop, collecting rent and gossip

knowledge: Brask's workshop lease is up at the end of the season
A Grid surveyor, Corvin Hale, has made her an offer for the building; it's more than she'll ever see otherwise
Her late husband, Arvo, kept the lower stairs' pumps running for forty years
The Drowned Saints raised the tithe this month

secrets.text: She's signed the Grid's offer for the building, to take effect at the end of the season unless someone matches it. She hasn't told Brask, and she can't look at him.
secrets.summary: Has signed the Grid's offer for Brask's building.
secrets.tell: Jingles her keys and changes the subject

relations.note: her tenant for nine years and the closest thing to a son she has; she charges him full rent
